description: One PassMaster question: MCQ, SAQ, DBQ, or LEQ. Modeled on the AP Calculus question schema; adapted to AP U.S. History (no math, no calculator, history skills/themes/reasoning).

answerKey.description: MCQ only. Must match one option key.

difficulty.description: 2 easy, 3 medium, 4 hard; 1 and 5 reserved for true extremes.

text.description: Text documents only; public-domain or paraphrased.

figures.description: Real artifacts or real-data charts only. Generated images banned as evidence.

file.description: Path relative to the shared image pool ~/workspace/apush/assets/images/.

explanation_figures.description: Supporting visuals for the explanation only where the visual makes the reasoning visible (LESSON-SPEC section 7). Same shape as figures; same shared pool.

file.description: Path relative to the shared image pool ~/workspace/apush/assets/images/.

grounding.description: Grounding layer (SPEC section 13). Every question traces its facts to a book passage or a cited primary source.

books.description: At least one book passage. Book ids: barrons-2027, 5steps-2024, princeton-25e.

primary_sources.description: Cited primary sources the question draws on, if any. Plain string, or a work/note object (Unit 1 Las Casas/Sepulveda items).

id.description: Stable id. The infix must match type. Ranges per SPEC.md section 4.

lesson.description: The lesson that teaches toward this question (LESSON-SPEC section 4), e.g. apush-u1-l1. Added at unit tie-out.

modelOutline.description: DBQ and LEQ: thesis + evidence grouping + complexity move.

options.description: MCQ only. Exactly 4 options, keys A-D.

misconception.description: Required on every distractor; forbidden on the correct option.

parts.description: SAQ only: exactly 3 parts, 1 point each.

pool.description: Assigned at authoring per BLUEPRINT.md. Never in both pools.

prompt.description: DBQ and LEQ: the question. DBQ range must fall inside 1754-1980.

rationales.description: MCQ only. Per-option explanation plus general note.

general.description: Numbered reasoning steps, 60-120 words, ending with a Remember: line.

rubric.description: DBQ (7 points) and LEQ (6 points). One decision rule per point. Rubric entries carry a CB skill label per cb-codes.json (thesis 6.A, contextualization 4.B, evidence 6.B, sourcing 3.B).

saq_slot.description: SAQ only: 1 secondary text, 2 primary text, 3 non-text.

source.description: Provenance. Never cite a source not consulted.

stem.description: MCQ only. One task per stem.

stimulus.description: MCQ stimuli carry kind; SAQ stimuli carry type plus source/rights (bank convention since Unit 2). LEQs are stimulus-free and carry null.

source_note.description: Where the stimulus came from and its rights status.

text.description: Verbatim stimulus, labeled paraphrase, or markdown data table.

stimulus_set.description: Id shared by the 2-5 MCQ questions on one stimulus. SAQ stimuli are unique per question so SAQ carries null; LEQ carries null (stimulus-free).

topics.description: CED topic codes. topics[0] is primary and must be in the question's unit.

title: APUSH PassMaster Question
